authorization: 用户要求：L2 隐私保护与 DAB 失败识别一起冻结成一个版本；Pcurrent 立即指向 P4。
scope_vs_P3: L2 outbound privacy gate on everything sent to the advisor (advisor_mode.privacy, default off)
DataAgentBench tool failures counted by the intervention trigger (always on; missing __RESULT__ marker excluded)
unchanged_vs_P3: advisor request templates and consultation tool
trigger thresholds, recent_messages=20, 800-char text/result clip, 300-char tool-argument clip

privacy_switch.set_in: agent.json only; not exposed in the console UI or API
privacy_switch.on: successful tool results replaced by a shape description; values first seen in tool results and unlisted numbers > 10 replaced by placeholders in every advisor-bound text; placeholders restored locally in advisor replies; error text masked and sent

threat_model: accidental leakage only (honest worker, curious advisor)
known_privacy_gaps: values written in another form (2020-11 vs November) are not matched
values shorter than 4 characters that are not all caps are not indexed
integers up to 10 are not masked
intended_arms: P4 privacy off (= P3 + DAB failure detection)
change_policy: Preserve P4; freeze subsequent implementation changes under a new version.
